stem: Which statement explains an effect of the Missouri Compromise?

options.label: F
options.text: The compromise maintained the balance between the number of free states and slave states in the Senate.

options.label: G
options.text: The compromise allowed slaves to be counted toward a state's population for representation in Congress.

options.label: H
options.text: The compromise enabled Southerners to pursue fugitive slaves into the North.

options.label: J
options.text: The compromise ended the slave trade in Washington, D.C.
